name: wildwood_scourge_ignores_a_counter_on_an_opponents_creature
notes: Printed: 'Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another non-Hydra creature you control, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' Your Scourge has two counters. The opponent controls Ajani's Pridemate; Thornwood Falls enters under the opponent's control and the opponent gains 1 life: their Pridemate gets a counter. Not a creature you control, so your Scourge stays at two.
